items.cite: Mark Everist and Thomas Forrest Kelly, eds, *The Cambridge History of Medieval Music* (Cambridge University Press, 2018).
items.note: Covers chant, liturgy, vernacular song and the emergence of polyphony, including organum, conductus and motet.
An introduction to chant in its liturgical setting; the linked chapter explains its place within church services.
